factual_entities.name_en: Snake Charmers (Kalbeliyas) & 4 Venomous Snakes of India
factual_entities.name_hi: सँपेरे (कालबेलिया) और भारत के 4 जहरीले सांप
attributes: Kalbeliya Community: Saperas of Rajasthan; Been party instruments: Been, Tumba, Khanjiri (made of dried bottle gourd / lauki), Dhol; Naag Gumphan rangoli/embroidery in Saurashtra Gujarat
4 Venomous Snakes of India: 1. Spectacled Cobra (नाग), 2. Common Krait (करैत), 3. Russell's Viper (दुबोइया), 4. Saw-scaled Viper (अफ़ई)
Fangs & Anti-venom: 2 hollow fangs inject poison; Anti-venom medicine is PREPARED FROM SNAKE'S OWN VENOM
Ecological Value: Snakes eat rats in farm fields, protecting crops

visual_assets_and_diagram_cues: Cobra hood, Krait banded rings, Russell's viper spots, Saw-scaled viper, Been party instruments
